originals.citation: Gilbert, N., & Meyer, C. (2003). Social anxiety and social comparison: differential links with restrictive and bulimic attitudes among nonclinical women. Eating Behaviors, 4(3), 257-264.

quote: Preliminary research has found a link between restrictive eating attitudes and a fear of negative evaluation (FNE). ... The current study sought to replicate and extend these findings
notes: Self-replication inferred: Gilbert & Meyer 2003 found FNE predicted drive for thinness (restrictive) but not bulimic attitudes, the finding re-tested. Full text not accessed; other 'preliminary research' may also be cited.
